name: Duckz
summary: Reject humanity. Return to- duck? Duckz is a social game inspired by Gorilla Tag. Instead of simply moving with a joystick, you move with your hands! Run around and explore the forest! Try on some cosmetics! Fly around in zero gravity! Duckz is a great game for meeting new people, so try it out! You never know, you could meet a brand new friend!
